message.content: {"action":"switch_architecture","reason":"Current LUT-linear design only reaches the 8-LSB quality target at phase_bits=16 with area 1584.6 um2; lower-precision LUT variants fail quality, and LUT depth/interpolation/precision changes are either exhausted or unavailable. Switching architecture is the only legal unvisited neighbor and may improve the area/quality tradeoff by using a CORDIC structure instead of further expanding LUT precision."}
